Lunch in the Lobby at Delmont Tower
A different local restaurant every week, just steps from your desk
Delmont Tower Management is pleased to announce Lunch in the Lobby, a new program for employees of the building's tenant companies. Beginning September 2, a food vendor will serve lunch in the main lobby every weekday from 11:30 A.M. to 1:30 P.M. --[1]--.
Last spring, we asked tenants what would most improve their workday. The most frequent answer concerned lunch. Many respondents said the nearest restaurants are a fifteen-minute walk away and are crowded by noon. --[2]--. With breaks often as short as thirty minutes, that leaves little time to actually eat.
To keep things interesting, a different local business will take over the lobby counter each week, offering anything from soups and salads to noodle dishes. Every vendor was chosen because its menu can be prepared ahead and served in just a few minutes. --[3]--.
Orders are placed and collected at the counter near the main entrance. A seating area with forty chairs has also been set aside beside the east elevators. Because this space is reserved for tenant employees during program hours, please be ready to show your tenant badge to the attendant at its entrance. --[4]--.
If the program proves popular, we plan to add a morning service with coffee and baked goods early next year.
Questions or vendor suggestions? Call the Delmont Tower Management Office at extension 3065.

Summer Backstage Tours
Thank you for joining us for this evening's performance. It is the final show of our season, and there will be no performances until the fall. During these quiet weeks, we would like to show you the parts of the Pembury Theater that audiences never see.
Each free, one-hour tour is led by a member of our stage crew and includes the main stage, the scenery workshop, and the dressing rooms. Tours run on weekday mornings from June 16 to July 11.
How to Book
E-mail
[email protected]
by June 9 with your preferred date and the number of people in your group. Because space backstage is limited, each booking may include no more than four people.
On the day, please arrive ten minutes early at the side entrance and wear flat shoes, as some stairs are steep.
We look forward to welcoming you backstage.
Yolanda Esposito
Theater Director
----------------------
To:
[email protected]
From: Ivan Lachance
Date: May 29
Subject: Backstage tour
Dear Box Office Team,
I attended your final performance and would like to book a backstage tour on June 25 for three people: my wife, my daughter, and me. Our daughter studies theater design and is eager to see the scenery workshop.
Could you also tell me where to park? You can reach me by phone at 555-0148.
Best regards,
Ivan Lachance
----------------------
To: Ivan Lachance
From:
[email protected]
Date: May 30
Subject: RE: Backstage tour
Dear Mr. Lachance,
Thank you for your e-mail. Three places are reserved for you on the 10 A.M. tour on June 25. A public parking garage is one block north of the theater.
As a thank-you, each of you will receive our illustrated book on the theater's history after the tour.
We started these tours for several reasons. Our stage was rebuilt last winter, and we want to show it to our supporters. The tours are also a way to thank our audience for a busy season, and we hope some visitors will join the volunteers who build our scenery.
We look forward to meeting your family.
Sincerely,
Nadia Lund
Box Office Manager
Pembury Theater
